intro: The Covert Ops Pack is a kit of specialized demolitions gear and operational schematics assembled for Alliance espionage in the Stonetalon Mountains. Designed to dismantle the Venture Company's rapacious presence in Windshear Crag, the satchel equips agents to trigger coordinated sabotage while securing high-value technical intelligence.

p: Issued for clandestine strikes deep within Venture Company territory, the Covert Ops Pack pairs brute destructive power with tactical precision. Inside are color-coded NG-5 explosives matched to remote triggers, alongside thorough instructions designated Plan Alpha and Plan Beta. The strategy relies on triggering high-yield distractions at key infrastructure nodes—namely the Cragpool Lake lumber mill and the eastern mine. While goblins scramble to extinguish blazes and assess mechanical failures, an infiltrator slips past the chaos to pilfer critical documents and schematics.

The contents of the pack serve a dual purpose for the Alliance in Stonetalon. For the night elf Sentinels, the detonations and theft disrupt the merciless clear-cutting and gouging of the sacred mountainside. For Alliance tinkers, the primary reward lies in the documents themselves. Recovering Venture Company engineering schematics offers rare insights into goblin heavy machinery, revealing mechanical weak points to exploit and allowing Alliance engineers to adapt industrial innovations into their own designs.
